findings.finding: NodeKind values and categories did not match the serialized IDL.
findings.correction: Added canonical NodeKind values ANCHOR=0 through ZONE_ACCESS=5 and retained TopologyNodeKind as a compatibility alias.

findings.finding: Adjacency exposed only the canonical from_node direction.
findings.correction: Derived reverse traversal views while preserving the canonical edge ID and reversed polyline.

findings.finding: Clearance and topology fields required by the IDL were absent.
findings.correction: Added node clearance/articulation/semantic fields and edge clearance, width validity, bridge, state and cost fields.

findings.finding: The proposed patch in the attached audit still omitted SpectralSignature scope metadata and used invented reverse edge IDs.
findings.correction: Added center node, hop/count, affinity and validity metadata; reverse views retain the original edge identity so overlays remain addressable.

findings.finding: The proposed patch used string node/edge identifiers although the normative IDL declares uint64.
findings.correction: Topology contract now validates non-negative integer identifiers.

verification.required_follow_up: Run the full pure-core regression after implementation changes.

remaining_limits: Topology extraction, graph migration and swept-footprint validation are not implemented by this contract module.
ROS 2 generated serialization remains untested on this Windows host.
Clearance values are supplied by a future calibrated/profile-owned extractor; no defaults are treated as deployment calibration.
